name: Death Diary
summary: Keeps a record of where and at which level each of your characters died, so you see which zones are the most dangerous for you.
logoPrompt: An old leather-bound diary lying open with a small pale skull resting on its pages and a red ribbon bookmark hanging out

cover.tagline: Where you died, and at which level.
bullets: Every death with zone and level

description: **Death Diary notes every death of your character with the zone, the spot and the level, and shows you where you die most.**
- Each death is noted with zone, sub-zone, character level and time.
- A summary of your deaths, your top zones and your deaths per level bracket.
- A list of your last 10 deaths.
- A small window with deaths per zone and per level.
- Every character keeps its own diary.

It starts on its own. Type `/dd` for the summary and all commands. `/dd last` lists your last deaths, `/dd window` opens the window, `/dd quiet on` turns off the chat line after a death, `/dd reset confirm` clears the diary of this character.
- It does not know what killed you: it never reads combat data, only where and when you died.
- The newest 500 deaths per character are kept.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
